_note: The owner (2026-09-30): a collection of 250 products, a mixed order of basketball jerseys, football shirts and shorts, the most popular in the world, for the influencer barter platform they work with (it takes up to 250 products; each influencer picks one or two). A manual collection in admin, on no sales channel (not on the site), with seo.hidden = 1 so it stays out of the sitemap and search if it is ever published. Its order is set by hand (MANUAL).

collection.title: שיתופי פעולה
collection.channels: none (Online Store, Point of Sale and Google & YouTube are the store's only channels)

rules: Adults only (no kids sets, kids jerseys or hoodies); ACTIVE products on the Online Store.

Football: the biggest clubs and national teams by global following (Real Madrid, Barcelona, Manchester United and City, Arsenal, Chelsea, PSG, Bayern, Juventus, Milan, Inter, Dortmund, Atlético; Argentina, Brazil, Portugal, France, England, Germany, Spain, Italy, ...), mostly 26/27 and World Cup 2026 kits, 1 to 4 kits per team. Israel and Maccabi Haifa are in for the Israeli audience. Liverpool has no product in the store.

Basketball jerseys: the best-selling players now and the legends (LeBron James, Stephen Curry, Michael Jordan, Kobe Bryant, Luka Doncic, Giannis, Wembanyama, Tatum, Edwards, Gilgeous-Alexander, Jokic, Durant, ...), a cap per player and one per team + colour + style, so nothing looks twice.

Shorts: 50 of the 116, spread over the popular teams; 49 are the matching shorts of a jersey in the collection (the set pairs in sportwear.complements) and come right after it, so an influencer can pick a full set. The Charlotte white shorts have no matching jersey and follow a Hornets jersey.
Left out: the four products flagged for the owner (sw-jerseys-105462222, sw-jerseys-152407516, sw-jerseys-125774963, sw-jerseys-135857824), WNBA, and the two 'מריה' print shirts.
Order: most popular first, mixed: a football shirt, then a basketball jersey (with its shorts when the pair is in), and so on.
